releases.raw_summary:
NoteAdds SSH port forwarding to the NAT manager, refactors iptables handling with MASQUERADE and status checks, updates usage/README, and bumps version to 1.1.3.

Scripts:

bin/suh_ai_proxy_manager.sh:

Add SSH port forwarding (localhost:2023 → 172.30.1.14:2023) alongside AI service.
Refactor into reusable apply_nat/remove_nat and check_single_rule functions.
Add POSTROUTING MASQUERADE rules; improve status output (lists PREROUTING).
Update usage/help and install checks.




Versioning:

Update version.yml to version: "1.1.3", version_code: 8; adjust flutter/basic patterns; refresh metadata timestamp.


Docs:

Update README.md latest version to v1.1.1 (2025-11-07) and remove legacy auto-version section.
